title: SS27 Toddler Boys' Knit Fabric Direction
summary: Knits for toddler boys: organic cotton jersey and interlock, terry, rib and UPF swim.
research_period: Pitti Bimbo 103, Florence, 24-25 June 2026; Playtime Paris, 28-30 June 2026; analysis July to November 2026
markets: Premium and mid-market childrenswear, Europe-led fairs, global retail

sections.heading: The evidence
sections.body:
- Salt and Pepper describes its SS27 fabrics as sustainable organic cotton, "exceptionally soft and gentle on the skin"<sup>[1]</sup>
- Cadhan showed soft organic cotton pyjamas, with a "Sogni d'oro" line for sensitive skin<sup>[2]</sup>
- Swimwear, T-shirts and accessories with built-in UV filters were prominent and are becoming common, linked to family concern for health and to changing climate<sup>[3]</sup>

sections.heading: Fabric by fabric
sections.body:
| Knit | Uses |
|---|---|
| Organic interlock | Rompers, sleepwear |
| Jersey | Tees |
| Terry | Sets, towels |
| UPF swim | Swim |

design_implications:
- Test for skin-safety and colour fastness.
- Safety: no drawstrings or long cords at the hood, neck or waist, in line with EN 14682; test the attachment strength of buttons, snaps and decorations, and keep small detachable parts off baby and toddler pieces.
